held_out_system.source: Serra-Marin et al. 2025 Methods in Ecology and Evolution
held_out_system.independence: Cabrera was not used to build ABM v4-v8, the Ogasawara diagnosis, the Menorca v5 falsification, or the Giannutri v6 falsification. It is a new island, time period and source dataset, although it is in the same broader Balearic region as Menorca; a Cabrera pass alone therefore cannot establish broad geographic generality.

source_native_reconstruction.method_reason: The pre-target source audit shows method=obs contains explicit no-pollinator sampling rows: 307 rows have blank Pollinator and N ind=0. Method=rpi has no zero N ind rows and therefore does not provide equivalent explicit support-absence ascertainment. The primary pair-support test uses obs for this source-structural reason, not because of any network outcome.
source_native_reconstruction.network_unit_reason: README defines COMMUNITY as community/site identifier and visita as sampling visit identifier. Use only source-observed obs COMMUNITY x visita combinations; absent combinations are not imputed as zero-interaction networks because the source has no rows proving that they were sampled.
source_native_reconstruction.plant_identity: Plant sp canonicalized by the pre-existing channel_id.external_archipelago_network.canonical_label rule. The pre-target audit found zero whitespace/case variant collisions.
source_native_reconstruction.pollinator_identity: Pollinator canonicalized by the same pre-existing canonical_label rule. The pre-target audit found zero whitespace/case variant collisions.
source_native_reconstruction.weight_reason: README defines N ind as number of pollinator individuals recorded. It is the direct source interaction-count quantity. N visit flowers measures how many flowers were visited within an event and is not substituted or selected by v8 fit.
source_native_reconstruction.pair_aggregation: Within each locked obs COMMUNITY x visita context, sum positive numeric N ind over duplicate canonical Plant sp x Pollinator rows.
source_native_reconstruction.zero_and_blank_rule: Rows with blank Pollinator and N ind=0 are retained as evidence that a flowering-plant census occurred with no recorded pollinator, but they create no pair and contribute zero interaction weight. The pre-target audit found no nonblank Pollinator row with N ind=0. Rows from missing COMMUNITY x visita combinations are not created or treated as zeros.
source_native_reconstruction.habitat_role: Retained as source metadata only. It is not a primary grouping field because the pre-target audit shows habitat is not one-to-one with COMMUNITY.
source_native_reconstruction.rpi_role: Not used in the primary validation because its source rows contain no explicit zero N ind records. It may only be considered in a separately frozen observation-layer robustness analysis and cannot rescue the primary obs result.

conditional_local_layer_test.reason: This validation tests the v8 local support/realization layer conditional on Cabrera's empirically observed pooled pair opportunity; it does not attempt to infer a whole-community v4 opportunity field for Cabrera.
conditional_local_layer_test.pooled_opportunity_baseline: Pool all 55 locked obs contexts, summing positive N ind by canonical plant x pollinator pair. The opportunity pair set is exactly the set of pairs with pooled positive N ind. Pooled pair weights are the summed N ind values.
conditional_local_layer_test.no_unobserved_pair_completion: Do not create plant x pollinator opportunities that were never positive anywhere in the 55-context pooled source. This conditional test asks whether v8 can generate observed local support branching within the empirically admitted opportunity union.

primary_estimands.median_pair_support_fraction: For each of 55 empirical contexts, active pair set = canonical pairs with aggregated N ind>0. Pair-support fraction = active-pair count divided by pooled-opportunity positive-pair count. Primary statistic is the median across the 55 contexts.
primary_estimands.mean_pair_support_jaccard_turnover: For every unordered pair of the 55 empirical contexts, turnover = 1 - |intersection of active pair sets| / |union|. If both sets are empty, turnover=0. Primary statistic is the arithmetic mean over all context pairs.
primary_estimands.interaction_shannon_relative_context_ran: For each context, compute Shannon diversity over positive aggregated N ind pair weights; define Shannon=0 for an empty interaction context. Statistic = (maximum context Shannon - minimum context Shannon) / pooled-opportunity baseline Shannon. If pooled baseline Shannon is non-positive or undefined, block rather than redefine the statistic.

secondary_diagnostics_not_headline_decis: median and range of active plant fraction relative to pooled positive plants
median and range of active pollinator fraction relative to pooled positive pollinators
count of empty local interaction contexts
Morisita-Horn plant niche overlap only where mathematically defined; it cannot replace a failed primary estimand

v8_predictive_distribution.baseline: checksum-locked pooled empirical obs opportunity network defined above
v8_predictive_distribution.support_process: Use the unchanged v8 hierarchy: v6-style pollinator availability followed by pair-level support inside globally active pollinators using the same frozen support strength. Do not condition pair masks on nonempty networks and do not redraw empty or sparse contexts.
v8_predictive_distribution.weight_process: Apply the unchanged v5 positive affinity reweighting after v8 support projection at the frozen weight strength.
v8_predictive_distribution.empty_context_rule: Empty synthetic local networks are retained. Their active pair set is empty and Shannon is 0 for the frozen empirical/predictive statistic.

decision_rule.model_structural_gate: Any violation of v8's existing no-new-taxon/link or retained-positive-row budget invariants is a structural failure and may not be skipped or redrawn.
decision_rule.predictive_envelopes: For each of the three primary estimands, use the equal-weight 1200-draw central 2.5-97.5% predictive envelope.
decision_rule.headline: v8 survives the Cabrera conditional repeated-local test only if the model structural gate passes and all three frozen primary empirical estimands lie inside their respective frozen predictive envelopes. Failure of any primary component is retained; primary metrics are not averaged into a pass.
decision_rule.secondary_diagnostics: Secondary plant/pollinator support and overlap diagnostics describe the failure/survival mode but cannot change the headline decision.

prohibited_after_target_calculation: change the primary method away from obs
add or drop any of the 55 locked COMMUNITY x visita contexts
impute any of the 23 absent COMMUNITY x visita combinations as zero-interaction networks
use habitat as a replacement network grouping after seeing outcomes
switch primary interaction weight from N ind to N visit flowers
drop blank-Pollinator zero rows in a way that changes interpretation of sampling absence
change plant or pollinator canonicalization after seeing target values
complete the pooled opportunity matrix with never-observed plant x pollinator pairs
select a preferred support or weight strength using Cabrera fit
skip, redraw, repair, or replace empty/sparse v8 contexts
use rpi or combined methods to rescue a failed obs primary test
reuse Menorca or Giannutri as confirmation of v8
claim_boundary: This is a prospective conditional test of v8 local pair-support branching and weighted realization on a new island dataset. It conditions on Cabrera's empirically observed pooled pair union, so it does not validate v4 whole-island opportunity. A pass would support the v8 local mechanism class under direct-observation ascertainment; a fail would identify a support sparsity, turnover, or weighted-architecture mismatch without permitting Cabrera-specific retuning.
